entry.name: mc.ramp~
entry.digest: Trigger a Single Ramp With an Audio Signal (multichannel)
entry.description: The ramp~ object generates a single signal ramp between a start and end value when it detects a change in an audio signal connected to its left inlet. The duration of the ramp can be a fixed value or based on the signal in ramp~'s second inlet.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: If a float argument tois present, it sets the initial value of theattribute. If a signal is connected to the second inlet, theattribute value is ignored in favor of the value of the signal.

attributes.name: curve
attributes.digest: Curvature
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the parameters of the exponential function that generates the non-linear output. It can range between -1 and 1. For ascending ramps, values ofless than 1 produce values above the linear input and values ofgreater than 1 produce values below the linear input. Asvalues near -1 or 1, the curavture becomes more extreme.

attributes.description: The curved output is a piecewise linear approximation of the exponential function. Theattribute sets the number of samples used for each line segement. If the signal vector size is less than, the actual segment length will be the signal vector size.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Duration Mode
attributes.description: Sets whether the duration of the ramp is recomputed if the value of the signal connected to the second (duration) inlet changes.

choices.digest: Duration is set at the start of the ramp and remains constant
Duration can change if the signal value connected to the right inlet changes.
choices.label: The total duration of the ramp is recomputed to take into account the elapsed time. For example, if the original ramp was 1000 ms, and the duration signal changes to 1500 ms after the ramp has been going for 400 ms, the ramp will continue for another 1100 ms. In this case the slope of the ramp will be reduced so it takes the extra time to reach the end value.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Trigger ramp, set duration, or set ramp start and end values
messages.description: A signal connected to the left inlet triggers the ramp when it goes from zero to non-zeroA signal connected to the second inlet sets the ramp durationA signal connected the third inlet sets the ramp start valueA signal connected the right inlet sets the ramp end value

inlets.description: An output ramp is triggered when the incoming signal goes from a zero to non-zero value.

If a signal is connected to the second inlet, the ramp duration is set according to the current setting of theattribute. Ifis 0, the value of the duration signal at the moment it starts becomes the unchanging duration of the ramp. Ifis 1, the duration can be updated over the course of the ramp if the value of the signal changes.

outlets.description: A signal ramp from thetovalues. After the ramp completes, the value is 0 if theattribute is enabled, otherwise it remains at thevalue.
